import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int s = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        long t = scanner.nextLong();

        GTakeMetro solver = new GTakeMetro();
        int result = solver.solve(n, m, s, t);
        System.out.println(result + 1);
        scanner.close();
    }

    static class GTakeMetro {
        int step(int n, long t, int s, int m) {
            int curJump = (int) (t % n);
            int sign = s < m ? 1 : -1;
            s += sign * curJump;
            s %= n;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
            return s;
        }

        int doLoop(int s, long t, int n, int m) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                s = step(n, t--, s, m);
            }
            return s;
        }

        public int solve(int n, int m, int s, long t) {
            while (t != 0) {
                s = step(n, t--, s, m);
            }
            long[] lastSeem = new long[n];
            int round = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) lastSeem[i] = -1;
            while (t != 0) {
                s = doLoop(s, t, n, m);
                t -= n;
                if (lastSeem[s] != -1) {
                    long interval = lastSeem[s] - t;
                    t %= interval;
                    break;
                } else {
                    lastSeem[s] = round++;
                }
            }
            while (t != 0) {
                s = step(n, t--, s, m);
            }
            return s;
        }
    }
}
